observations: The page number «35» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «5*» on the right. L01: «keit» completes «Giltig-» at the end of p. 34 (JP2 0066, L40).

L25-L30: the intervals between the eras, set as a table of six rows: the names are joined to the figures by dotted leaders, which are not transcribed, and the units «Jahre», «Mon.» and «Tg.» are repeated by ditto marks, „; L27 ends with Suter's «(?)». Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells after the first give its words room and are not printed.

L19-L22: «IIDCCXCIII» is printed without a bar; in L21 the «II» that Suter says should be written is printed with a bar over it, as {ov:II}. Checked: MMDCCXCIII is 2793. The table agrees with this figure: 2356 years 7 months 23 days and 436 years 6 months 12½ days, with months of thirty days, make 2793 years 2 months 5½ days, the time from the Deluge to the era of Alexander that the addition gives.

L28-L30. Checked: from the era of the Seleucids, 1 October 312 B.C., to 1 January of the first year A.D. are 311 Julian years and 3 months (113685 days); from 1 January A.D. 1, 621 years 6 months 15 days reach 16 July 622, the civil epoch of the Hijra; from the astronomical epoch, 15 July 622, to 16 June 632 are 3624 days, which are 9 years of 365 days, 11 months of 30 days and 9 days, al-Battānī's 9 years 11 months 9 days, where the table has 4 days (see p. XV, JP2 0019).

Note 1: the era of Nabonassar. Checked: from 26 February 747 B.C. to 1 October 312 B.C. are 159101 days, 435 Egyptian years of 365 days, 10 months of 30 days and 26 days, or 435 Julian years 7 months 5 days; neither agrees with the 436 years 6 months 12½ days of L27, as the note says.

L31-L37: the Spanish era («Aera azofar», «ta’rīkh al-ṣufr»), 38 years before the Christian era; the four lines of Table 1 that Suter cites are to be compared with the table. L32: «Maslamas» in italics, where the name is spaced elsewhere (L12). L36: a speck on the base line after «2»; L30: a speck above the line before «der»; L03: a speck above the line after «Februario.»; not transcribed. L29: a thin oblique stroke, lighter than the print, between the ditto mark after «6» and «15»; not transcribed.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Nallino», «Kh.», «Maslama», the names of the table, «Ptol.», «Batt.»; italics: the Latin quotations, the Arabic words, «Alphonsinischen», «Seleucidischen Aera», «Diluvium», «Hidjra», «Aera azofar», «Aera Nabonassars», «Bukhtanassar primus». L22: «2793 J. 2 M. 5 T.», years, months, days.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (11-15 px measured; «debeant ;», in italics, 12 px).
